component.name: Disc Image Studio
component.summary: Create and burn visible artwork on optical discs

description.p: Disc Image Studio turns a picture into data that meets the physical-layer constraints of CD, DVD and single-layer BD-R media. After burning, the picture is visible on the data side of the disc.
This is the GTK 4 / libadwaita edition of the application for GNOME and other Linux desktops.

ul.li: Layer-based disc designer with tone and dithering controls
Design projection and read-back preview of generated images
ISO, WAV + CUE and RAW export
Experimental live burning through cdrskin and xorriso
Assisted calibration from a photo of a burned test disc
